accuracy.evidence: Matches NC Y2 basic needs (water, food, air) and plant needs (water, light, suitable temperature); NGSS K-LS1-1 what plants/animals need; need vs want distinction is standard PSHE/science framing.

misconceptions.evidence: Targets toys/TV as false needs, plants 'eating' without light, fish in deserts, and ignoring air — each appears in challenge feedback and adult notes.

lab_distinct.evidence: Lab is survival-needs sorting and care (puppy, seedling, missing water, pond vs desert) — distinct from living/not-living classification (flagalive) and from plants-need-water-and-light alone (flagsprout).

lab_teaches.evidence: Learner must give each need and choose a suitable place; discovery happens before confirmation text.

predictions.evidence: Wrong options (toy car, TV, toy bone as essential) are the documented slips the next task overturns.

challenge_feedback.evidence: why() messages name want vs need, unsuitable place, food-as-decoration, and air-as-boredom slips specifically.

readability.evidence: Ages 5–7 wording: short kid lines, concrete puppy/plant/fish examples.

no_filler.evidence: No delve/journey phrasing; each line teaches a need, a want contrast, or a habitat point.

mobile.evidence: Large sort/care buttons; drag-to-bin and tap both work at phone width.

accessibility.evidence: Every drag has a button twin; live aria-label via say(); challenge status is aria-live.

sources: UK National Curriculum 2013 Science Year 2: Animals including humans — basic needs for survival (water, food and air)
UK National Curriculum 2013 Science Year 2: Plants — water, light and suitable temperature
NGSS K-LS1-1 Use observations to describe patterns of what plants and animals need to survive
